package_info.package_manager: N/A (malicious PDF document exploiting Foxit Reader)
package_info.package_versions: Foxit PDF Reader (versions vulnerable to the described exploit, specific versions not listed)
package_info.why_malicious: The malicious PDF leverages a design flaw in Foxit PDF Reader's warning dialogs, tricking users into executing a payload by presenting harmful default options. The PDF is crafted to exploit this flaw, resulting in the download and execution of remote malware.

execution_context.trigger: user interaction (after two warning dialogs in Foxit PDF Reader)
execution_context.file_location: malicious PDF file (embedded script or action)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: PDF action/script that, after user clicks through two warning dialogs, downloads and executes a payload from a remote server.
malicious_snippets.code_language: PDF embedded scripting (likely JavaScript or PDF action commands)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Upon user clicking through two warning dialogs, the embedded PDF script initiates a download of a remote payload and executes it on the victim's machine, resulting in code execution.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: PDFs should not download and execute remote code, especially after simple user prompts. The use of default options to facilitate this is highly suspicious.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal PDFs may contain links or forms, but should not trigger code execution or download executables after dialog confirmations.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some PDFs may use embedded scripts for form validation or document automation, but not for downloading and executing external payloads.
key_indicators: PDF triggers download and execution of remote payload
Relies on user clicking through warning dialogs with harmful default options
Abuses Foxit Reader's flawed warning dialog design

attack_chain.action: User opens the malicious PDF in Foxit PDF Reader.
attack_chain.leads_to: User is presented with warning dialogs.

attack_chain.action: User is shown two warning dialogs with default options that are harmful.
PDF embedded script/action is triggered, downloading and executing a remote payload.
attack_chain.leads_to: Remote code execution on victim's machine (malware infection).

behavioral_signatures: PDF files that trigger network connections to download executables
PDFs with embedded scripts/actions that execute after user dialog interaction
Unusual process creation from Foxit PDF Reader (e.g., spawning cmd.exe, powershell.exe, or downloaded binaries)
file_indicators: PDFs with embedded JavaScript or launch actions
PDFs that reference external URLs for payload download
network_indicators: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests from Foxit PDF Reader to unknown or suspicious domains
Download of executable content following PDF opening
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Foxit PDF Reader processes initiating network connections or spawning child processes. Flag PDFs with embedded JavaScript or launch actions, especially those referencing external URLs. Alert on user workflows where two or more warning dialogs are presented and subsequently a network download or process execution occurs.
